integrity: Analytic proof of dimension bound and explicit complete flow; independently executed symbolic and finite-precision helper program; historical-priority and independent scientific validation outstanding.
scientific_limitations: All-flows theorem applies to smooth autonomous two-dimensional manifolds at regular periodic orbits, not equilibria or arbitrary recurrent sets. Three-dimensional construction is a sharpness example, not a prevalence claim. Full text of the 2022 foundational publication was not inspected; priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp dimension barrier for reachable transient centers on periodic orbits
